params.prompt: Use image 1 as the exact base photograph: the real Mestrovic Pavilion and the real surrounding buildings of this Zagreb square. Keep the pavilion, every surrounding house, the skyline and the camera position exactly as they are in the photo, do not redesign or replace any building. Convert the whole scene into a black-and-white documentary photograph from the early 1960s with one unified tonal range: overcast soft daylight, the pavilion stone in the same mid-grey tonality as the houses around it (not brighter, not glowing white), gentle shading on the rotunda, natural film grain. Remove modern elements (modern cars, signs, flags, modern street furniture, modern road markings) and replace the foreground with a period street: asphalt and cobbles with tram tracks. Add life from the 1960s: one old Zagreb tram passing in front, painted pale blue, the ONLY coloured element in the image; several 1960s cars (small European sedans) driving and parked; pedestrians in 1960s coats, hats and dresses crossing the square, a couple of men with briefcases in the foreground. Photorealistic, no text, no captions.
